case explicit/first-failure

  recorded <m3:id> <m3:path> remove <digest:target:<m3:id>>

  row <m3:path> | not-attempted | clean | count=0 bytes=0 shown=0 truncated=false | none | <digest:plan> | not attempted; an earlier target in this set did not complete | reason-code= | assignment=<m3:id>

  member m2 tree=present ledger=active
  member m3 tree=present ledger=active
